verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents an Exports API: asynchronous export jobs that return a download URL to a zip/pdf of exported data. That is a first-party capability for bulk data export. However, the evidence never says which resources it covers (subscriptions, invoices, usage), and nothing addresses porting stored payment methods to another provider, which is half the story. Missing for 10: confirmation that exports cover subscriptions, invoices and usage records, payment-method portability or migration to another processor, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can export every subscription, invoice, and usage record — and port stored payment methods out to another provider — if I choose to leave

citations.quote: Export resource represents an export job and contains the status of the job and the download URL, if the job is successfully completed.
it will contain the download url pointing to the zip/pdf containing the exported data.
